title: Ambient particles, cave audio, reverb and ambience loops (absorbs P3-49)
player_outcome: Caves and biomes feel atmospheric: dust motes drifting in light shafts, glowing spores in mushroom caves, embers in the underworld, dripping water, falling leaves in forests, fireflies at night; caves get reverb and muffled sound by depth; every biome and layer has ambience loops (wind, birds, insects, water, lava rumble) and the music has rain/town/underground/night variants and a boss-defeat stinger; fishing bite sound.
design: Engine: pooled GPU particle emitters near the camera chosen by biome/layer/time (budget per preset), audio reverb/low-pass bus by depth/enclosure (sky-map exposure), ambience loop director on the Ambient bus (AmbientVolume slider already exists), music variants in MusicDirector + tools/audio composer; data/config/ambience.json.
Quality bar: what a AAA, realistic 3D Terraria made by Re-Logic would ship. Data-driven, performance-budgeted by graphics preset, Core logic tested, follows docs/overhaul/_BRIEF.md (LEAN MODE).
verification: probe ambience.loop / audio.reverb in a cave via smoke
